messages: Nina: quick design poll — for bulk invites, should we show org SSO as an editable control inside the modal or as a read-only "pill" that links to settings? also want a quick path to the audit view after large batches. sketches attached. Arin: i'm pro-pill. it signals policy without implying on-the-spot change. proposed placement: left of modal title, small info icon to open tooltip. Tess: accessibility checklist: the pill must be keyboard focusable, have aria-label that matches visible text, and point to a descriptive region via aria-describedby: 'SSO is required for this organization; changes are in Organization settings.' please ensure contrast >= 4.5:1. Vik: implementation idea: SSO required. settings page reads ?s=ssopanel and focuses the SSO heading. avoid mounting a toggle in the modal. Arin: copy debate — security wants "required" not "enforced". product ok with "SSO required". tooltip copy: 'Single sign-on is required for this organization. To change it, go to Organization settings.' Tess: tooltip must be in DOM; make it openable with Enter/Space and announced. also add a hidden "skip to audit" link at the top of the modal for screen-reader users to jump directly to the audit shortcut. Nina: audit workflow: footer link "Open invite activity" -> /orgs/:id/audit?filter=invites&from=modal. and include audit meta on batch events: add key "sso_status: required" so rows are self-describing for compliance. Vik: will prototype HTML/CSS + tiny JS for deep-link focus (no animation). will include keyboard tests and a VoiceOver/NVDA checklist in the PR. DeployBot: build queued for branch feat/invite-sso-pill at 2134568120 — https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/9999 Nina: thanks everyone. next: Arin update mocks with pill + tooltip copy, Vik pushes prototype to staging, run accessibility checks, then 2-admin usability test. small visual: increase pill min-width to 80px on mobile to avoid wrapping. :thumbsup:
